# `branch-cleanup.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| age_days | Minimum age in days (by last commit) before a branch is eligible | `number` | `30` | no |
| branch_pattern | ERE of branch names eligible for deletion | `string` | `^(bump|renovate)/` | no |
| dry_run | Log candidates without deleting | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array (e.g., ["self-hosted", "oke"]) | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04"]` | no |
